decisive_spans.text: CT of the thoracic spine showed an expansile bony lesion of the T1 vertebral body with extension into the left pedicle and posterior elements

response.rationale: The patient has a primary spinal tumor, as evidenced by the expansile bony lesion of the T1 vertebral body with extension into the left pedicle and posterior elements, and the absence of a primary malignancy elsewhere. Multiple myeloma is a possibility but is less specific than primary spinal tumor given the imaging findings.
